templates.name: Rybbit
templates.description: Privacy-friendly web analytics with sessions, funnels and goals.
templates.note: Open the site and sign up: the first account is the admin.
templates.compose:
services:
  # Sends /api to the backend and the rest to the dashboard.
  proxy:
    image: caddy:2-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    configs:
      - source: caddyfile
        target: /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
    depends_on:
      - backend
      - client
  backend:
    image: ghcr.io/rybbit-io/rybbit-backend:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      BASE_URL: ${BASE_URL}
      BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: ${BETTER_AUTH_SECRET}
      DISABLE_SIGNUP: "false"
      DISABLE_TELEMETRY: "true"
      CLICKHOUSE_HOST: http://clickhouse:8123
      CLICKHOUSE_DB: analytics
      CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD: ${CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD}
      CLICKHOUSE_QUERY_PASSWORD: ${CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_HOST: postgres
      POSTGRES_PORT: "5432"
      POSTGRES_DB: analytics
      POSTGRES_USER: rybbit
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      REDIS_HOST: redis
      REDIS_PORT: "6379"
      REDIS_PASSWORD: ${REDIS_PASSWORD}
      CLUSTER_WORKERS: "2"
    depends_on:
      clickhouse:
        condition: service_healthy
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
  client:
    image: ghcr.io/rybbit-io/rybbit-client:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL: ${BASE_URL}
      NEXT_PUBLIC_DISABLE_SIGNUP: "false"
    depends_on:
      - backend
  clickhouse:
    image: clickhouse/clickhouse-server:26.3
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      CLICKHOUSE_DB: analytics
      CLICKHOUSE_USER: default
      CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD: ${CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD}
      CLICKHOUSE_DEFAULT_ACCESS_MANAGEMENT: "1"
    configs:
      - source: clickhouse-network
        target: /etc/clickhouse-server/config.d/network.xml
      - source: clickhouse-logging
        target: /etc/clickhouse-server/config.d/logging_rules.xml
      - source: clickhouse-user-settings
        target: /etc/clickhouse-server/users.d/user_settings.xml
    volumes:
      - clickhouse-data:/var/lib/clickhouse
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:8123/ping"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 20
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: rybbit
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: analytics
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U rybbit -d analytics"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 20
  redis:
    image: redis:8-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["redis-server", "--requirepass", "${REDIS_PASSWORD}", "--appendonly", "yes", "--maxmemory-policy", "noeviction"]
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "-a", "${REDIS_PASSWORD}", "--no-auth-warning", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 10
configs:
  caddyfile:
    content: |
      {
        admin off
        auto_https off
        servers {
          trusted_proxies static private_ranges
        }
      }
      :80 {
        request_body {
          max_size 50MB
        }
        handle /api/* {
          reverse_proxy backend:3001
        }
        handle /.well-known/oauth-* {
          reverse_proxy backend:3001
        }
        handle /.well-known/openid-configuration* {
          reverse_proxy backend:3001
        }
        handle {
          reverse_proxy client:3002
        }
      }
  clickhouse-network:
    content: |
      <clickhouse>
          <listen_host>0.0.0.0</listen_host>
      </clickhouse>
  clickhouse-logging:
    content: |
      <clickhouse>
        <logger>
            <level>warning</level>
            <console>true</console>
        </logger>
        <query_thread_log remove="remove"/>
        <query_log remove="remove"/>
        <query_views_log remove="remove"/>
        <query_metric_log remove="remove"/>
        <error_log remove="remove"/>
        <opentelemetry_span_log remove="remove"/>
        <text_log remove="remove"/>
        <trace_log remove="remove"/>
        <metric_log remove="remove"/>
        <asynchronous_metric_log remove="remove"/>
        <session_log remove="remove"/>
        <part_log remove="remove"/>
        <latency_log remove="remove"/>
        <processors_profile_log remove="remove"/>
      </clickhouse>
  clickhouse-user-settings:
    content: |
      <clickhouse>
        <profiles>
          <default>
            <enable_json_type>1</enable_json_type>
            <async_insert>1</async_insert>
            <wait_for_async_insert>1</wait_for_async_insert>
            <log_queries>0</log_queries>
            <log_query_threads>0</log_query_threads>
            <log_processors_profiles>0</log_processors_profiles>
          </default>
        </profiles>
      </clickhouse>
volumes:
  clickhouse-data:
  postgres-data:
  redis-data:

templates.name: Satisfactory

services:

      SEAFILE_MYSQL_DB_CCNET_DB_NAME: ccnet_db
      SEAFILE_MYSQL_DB_SEAFILE_DB_NAME: seafile_db
      SEAFILE_MYSQL_DB_SEAHUB_DB_NAME: seahub_db
      TIME_ZONE: Etc/UTC
      INIT_SEAFILE_ADMIN_EMAIL: ${ADMIN_EMAIL}
      INIT_SEAFILE_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      SEAFILE_SERVER_HOSTNAME: ${SEAFILE_SERVER_HOSTNAME}
      SEAFILE_SERVER_PROTOCOL: https
      SITE_ROOT: /
      NON_ROOT: "false"
      JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${JWT_PRIVATE_KEY}
      SEAFILE_LOG_TO_STDOUT: "true"
      ENABLE_GO_FILESERVER: "true"
      ENABLE_SEADOC: "false"
      CACHE_PROVIDER: redis
      REDIS_HOST: redis
      REDIS_PORT: "6379"
      REDIS_PASSWORD: ""

      start_period: 30s

    image: redis:8-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["redis-server", "--save", "", "--appendonly", "no"]

templates.name: SearXNG
templates.description: Private metasearch engine that aggregates results without tracking.

services:

templates.name: SeaweedFS
templates.description: Distributed storage for billions of files, with an S3 API and an admin web UI.
templates.note: The admin UI is on the main domain; sign in as admin with the generated password. The S3 API has a domain of its own and uses the S3 access key and secret key.
templates.compose:
services:
  # Master, volume, filer and S3 gateway in one process.
  seaweedfs:
    image: chrislusf/seaweedfs:4.48
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["server", "-dir=/data", "-master.port=9333", "-s3", "-s3.port=8333", "-s3.config=/etc/seaweedfs/s3.json"]
    configs:
      - source: s3-config
        target: /etc/seaweedfs/s3.json
    volumes:
      - seaweedfs-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -q -O /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:9333/cluster/status"]
      interval: 10s
      retries: 30
  admin:
    image: chrislusf/seaweedfs:4.48
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["admin", "-master=seaweedfs:9333", "-port=23646", "-dataDir=/data", "-adminUser=admin", "-adminPassword=${ADMIN_PASSWORD}"]
    volumes:
      - seaweedfs-admin-data:/data
    depends_on:
      seaweedfs:
        condition: service_healthy
configs:
  s3-config:
    content: |
      {
        "identities": [
          {
            "name": "admin",
            "credentials": [{ "accessKey": "${S3_ACCESS_KEY}", "secretKey": "${S3_SECRET_KEY}" }],
            "actions": ["Admin", "Read", "ReadAcp", "List", "Tagging", "Write", "WriteAcp"]
          }
        ]
      }
volumes:
  seaweedfs-data:
  seaweedfs-admin-data:

templates.name: Send
templates.description: Share files with end-to-end encryption and links that expire.
templates.note: Anyone who can reach the domain can upload. Keep it private (IP allowlist) if that is not what you want.
templates.compose:
services:

    restart: unless-stopped
    # The image has no writable /uploads; root lets it use the volume.
    user: "0"
    environment:
      BASE_URL: ${BASE_URL}
      PORT: "1443"
      REDIS_HOST: redis
      FILE_DIR: /uploads
    volumes:
      - send-uploads:/uploads

  redis:

templates.name: Sequin
templates.description: Streams changes from PostgreSQL to Kafka, SQS, Redis, webhooks and other sinks in real time.
templates.note: Sign in with the admin email and password below (Variables tab). Sign-up is turned off.
templates.compose:
services:
  sequin:
    image: sequin/sequin:v0.14.6
    restart: unless-stopped
    # VAULT_KEY must be 32 bytes in base64: derived from the generated seed.
    entrypoint: ["sh", "-c", "export VAULT_KEY=$$(printf %s \"$$VAULT_SEED\" | head -c 32 | base64) && exec /scripts/start_commands.sh"]
    environment:
      SERVER_HOST: ${SERVER_HOST}
      SERVER_CHECK_ORIGIN: "true"
      PG_HOSTNAME: postgres
      PG_DATABASE: sequin
      PG_PORT: "5432"
      PG_USERNAME: sequin
      PG_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      PG_POOL_SIZE: "20"
      SECRET_KEY_BASE: ${SECRET_KEY_BASE}
      VAULT_SEED: ${VAULT_SEED}
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
      CONFIG_FILE_PATH: /config/sequin.yml
      FEATURE_ACCOUNT_SELF_SIGNUP: disabled
      SEQUIN_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: "true"
      CRASH_REPORTING_DISABLED: "true"
    configs:
      - source: sequin-config
        target: /config/sequin.yml
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["postgres", "-c", "wal_level=logical"]
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: sequin
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: sequin
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U sequin -d sequin"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 20
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 10
# Creates the account and the admin user on start.
configs:
  sequin-config:
    content: |
      account:
        name: default
      users:
        - email: "${ADMIN_EMAIL}"
          password: "${ADMIN_PASSWORD}"
volumes:
  postgres-data:
  redis-data:

templates.note: Sign in to the web client as admin with the generated admin password (Variables tab), then add IRC networks.
templates.compose:
services:
  # Web IRC client; it reaches the bouncer through the gamja-backend service below.
  gamja:
    image: codeberg.org/emersion/gamja:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - gamja-backend
  # The soju IRC bouncer.
  gamja-backend:
    image: codeberg.org/emersion/soju:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    entrypoint: ["/soju", "-config", "/soju-config"]
    configs:
      - source: soju-config
        target: /soju-config
    volumes:
      - soju-db:/db
      - soju-uploads:/uploads
      - soju-run:/run/soju
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/sojuctl", "-config", "/soju-config", "help"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 20
  # Adds the admin user on the first start; later runs find it and stop.
  create-admin:
    image: codeberg.org/emersion/soju:latest
    restart: "no"
    entrypoint: ["/sojuctl", "-config", "/soju-config", "user", "create", "-username", "admin", "-password", "${ADMIN_PASSWORD}", "-admin"]
    configs:
      - source: soju-config
        target: /soju-config
    volumes:
      - soju-db:/db
      - soju-run:/run/soju
    depends_on:
      gamja-backend:
        condition: service_healthy
configs:
  soju-config:
    content: |
      db sqlite3 /db/main.db
      message-store db
      file-upload fs /uploads/
      listen irc+insecure://0.0.0.0:6667
      listen ws+insecure://0.0.0.0:80
      listen unix+admin:///run/soju/admin
volumes:
  soju-db:
  soju-uploads:
  soju-run:

templates.name: Apache Superset
templates.description: Data exploration and dashboards on top of your SQL databases, with Postgres and Redis.
templates.note: Log in with the admin user and password below. The first start takes a minute while the database is set up.
templates.compose:
x-superset-env: &superset-env
  SUPERSET_CONFIG_PATH: /app/superset_config.py
  SUPERSET_SECRET_KEY: ${SUPERSET_SECRET_KEY}
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
services:
  superset:
    # The -dev image ships the Postgres driver the metadata database needs.
    image: apache/superset:6.1.0-dev
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment: *superset-env
    configs:
      - source: superset-config
        target: /app/superset_config.py
    volumes:
      - superset-home:/app/superset_home
    depends_on:
      init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
  # Migrates the database, creates the admin user and sets up roles. Safe to run on every start.
  init:
    image: apache/superset:6.1.0-dev
    restart: "no"
    environment:
      <<: *superset-env
      ADMIN_USER: ${ADMIN_USER}
      ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${ADMIN_PASSWORD}
    command:
      - sh
      - -c
      - superset db upgrade && superset fab create-admin --username "$$ADMIN_USER" --firstname Admin --lastname User --email admin@example.com --password "$$ADMIN_PASSWORD" && superset init
    configs:
      - source: superset-config
        target: /app/superset_config.py
    volumes:
      - superset-home:/app/superset_home
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: superset
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: superset
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U superset -d superset"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 20
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 10
configs:
  superset-config:
    content: |
      import os

      SECRET_KEY = os.environ["SUPERSET_SECRET_KEY"]
      SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI = f"postgresql+psycopg2://superset:{os.environ['POSTGRES_PASSWORD']}@postgres:5432/superset"
      # Trust the X-Forwarded-* headers from the proxy in front of the domain.
      ENABLE_PROXY_FIX = True

      def redis_cache(db, prefix):
          return {
              "CACHE_TYPE": "RedisCache",
              "CACHE_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT": 86400,
              "CACHE_KEY_PREFIX": prefix,
              "CACHE_REDIS_URL": f"redis://redis:6379/{db}",
          }

      CACHE_CONFIG = redis_cache(0, "superset_")
      DATA_CACHE_CONFIG = redis_cache(1, "superset_data_")
      FILTER_STATE_CACHE_CONFIG = redis_cache(2, "superset_filter_")
      EXPLORE_FORM_DATA_CACHE_CONFIG = redis_cache(3, "superset_explore_")
      RATELIMIT_STORAGE_URI = "redis://redis:6379/4"
volumes:
  superset-home:
  postgres-data:
  redis-data:

templates.description: Matrix homeserver for secure, decentralized chat.
templates.note: Registration is closed. Create users in the Console with: register_new_matrix_user -c /data/homeserver.yaml http://localhost:8008. The server name is the domain at first start and cannot change later. Use any Matrix client, such as the Element Web template.
templates.compose:
services:
  synapse:
    image: ghcr.io/element-hq/synapse:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      SYNAPSE_SERVER_NAME: ${SYNAPSE_SERVER_NAME}
      SYNAPSE_REPORT_STATS: "no"
    # Writes homeserver.yaml and the signing key on the first start, then runs Synapse.
    # serve_server_wellknown lets other servers federate over HTTPS on port 443.
    entrypoint:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        if [ ! -f /data/homeserver.yaml ]; then
          /start.py generate || exit 1
          printf 'public_baseurl: "https://%s/"\nserve_server_wellknown: true\n' "$$SYNAPSE_SERVER_NAME" >> /data/homeserver.yaml
        fi
        exec /start.py
    volumes:
      - synapse-data:/data
volumes:
  synapse-data:

templates.name: Synapse (PostgreSQL)
templates.description: Matrix homeserver for secure, decentralized chat, with PostgreSQL for larger servers.
templates.note: Registration is closed. Create users in the Console with: register_new_matrix_user -c /data/homeserver.yaml http://localhost:8008. The server name is the domain at first start and cannot change later. Use any Matrix client, such as the Element Web template.
templates.compose:
services:
  synapse:
    image: ghcr.io/element-hq/synapse:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      SYNAPSE_SERVER_NAME: ${SYNAPSE_SERVER_NAME}
      SYNAPSE_REPORT_STATS: "no"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
    # Writes homeserver.yaml and the signing key on the first start, switches it to PostgreSQL,
    # then runs Synapse. serve_server_wellknown lets other servers federate over HTTPS on port 443.
    entrypoint:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        if [ ! -f /data/homeserver.yaml ]; then
          /start.py generate || exit 1
          python3 -c '
        import os, yaml
        p = "/data/homeserver.yaml"
        c = yaml.safe_load(open(p))
        c["public_baseurl"] = "https://%s/" % os.environ["SYNAPSE_SERVER_NAME"]
        c["serve_server_wellknown"] = True
        c["database"] = {"name": "psycopg2", "args": {"user": "synapse", "password": os.environ["POSTGRES_PASSWORD"], "database": "synapse", "host": "postgres", "port": 5432, "cp_min": 5, "cp_max": 10}}
        yaml.safe_dump(c, open(p, "w"), sort_keys=False)
        ' || exit 1
        fi
        exec /start.py
    volumes:
      - synapse-data:/data
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: synapse
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: synapse
      # Synapse needs the C collation.
      POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: --encoding=UTF8 --lc-collate=C --lc-ctype=C
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U synapse -d synapse"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 20
volumes:
  synapse-data:
  postgres-data:

templates.name: Typebot
templates.description: Build chatbots with a visual editor and embed them anywhere.
templates.note: Typebot uses two domains: the main one is the builder, the second one serves your bots. Sign in uses links sent by email, so fill in the SMTP values. Sign in with the admin email to get full access.
templates.compose:
x-typebot-env: &typebot-env
  DATABASE_URL: postgresql://typebot:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/typebot
  REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
  ENCRYPTION_SECRET: ${ENCRYPTION_SECRET}
  NEXTAUTH_URL: ${BUILDER_URL}
  NEXT_PUBLIC_VIEWER_URL: ${VIEWER_URL}
  ADMIN_EMAIL: ${ADMIN_EMAIL}
  NODE_OPTIONS: --no-node-snapshot
  SMTP_HOST: ${SMTP_HOST}
  SMTP_PORT: ${SMTP_PORT}
  SMTP_USERNAME: ${SMTP_USERNAME:-}
  SMTP_PASSWORD: ${SMTP_PASSWORD:-}
  NEXT_PUBLIC_SMTP_FROM: ${SMTP_FROM}
services:
  builder:
    image: baptistearno/typebot-builder:3
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Typebot rejects empty SMTP credentials: drop them when the server needs no login.
    entrypoint: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "[ -n \"$$SMTP_USERNAME\" ] || unset SMTP_USERNAME SMTP_PASSWORD; exec ./$${SCOPE}-entrypoint.sh"]
    environment: *typebot-env
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
  viewer:
    image: baptistearno/typebot-viewer:3
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Typebot rejects empty SMTP credentials: drop them when the server needs no login.
    entrypoint: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "[ -n \"$$SMTP_USERNAME\" ] || unset SMTP_USERNAME SMTP_PASSWORD; exec ./$${SCOPE}-entrypoint.sh"]
    environment: *typebot-env
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: typebot
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: typebot
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U typebot -d typebot"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 20
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: --save 60 1 --loglevel warning
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 10
volumes:

      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--spider", "-q", "localhost:8123/ping"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 30
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: uptrace
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: uptrace
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U uptrace -d uptrace"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 20
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 10
configs:
  uptrace-config:
    content: |
      service:
        env: hosted
        secret: ${UPTRACE_SECRET}
      site:
        url: ${UPTRACE_URL}
        ingest_url: ${UPTRACE_URL}
      listen:
        http:
          addr: :80
        grpc:
          addr: :4317
      seed_data:
        update: true
        delete: false
        users:
          - key: user1
            name: Admin
            email: ${ADMIN_EMAIL}
            password: ${ADMIN_PASSWORD}
            email_confirmed: true
        orgs:
          - key: org1
            name: Org1
        org_users:
          - key: org_user1
            org_key: org1
            user_key: user1
            role: owner
        projects:
          - key: project1
            name: Project1
            org_key: org1
        project_tokens:
          - key: project_token1
            project_key: project1
            token: ${PROJECT_TOKEN}
        project_users:
          - key: project_user1
            project_key: project1
            org_user_key: org_user1
            perm_level: admin
      ch_cluster:
        cluster: uptrace1
        replicated: false
        distributed: false
        shards:
          - replicas:
              - addr: clickhouse:9000
                database: uptrace
                user: uptrace
                password: ${CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD}
                dial_timeout: 3s
                write_timeout: 5s
                max_retries: 3
                max_execution_time: 15s
      ch_schema:
        compression: ZSTD(1)
        spans_index: { storage_policy: default }
        spans_data: { storage_policy: default }
        span_links: { storage_policy: default }
        logs_index: { storage_policy: default }
        logs_data: { storage_policy: default }
        events_index: { storage_policy: default }
        events_data: { storage_policy: default }
        metrics: { storage_policy: default }
      pg:
        addr: postgres:5432
        user: uptrace
        password: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
        database: uptrace
      redis_cache:
        addrs:
          1: redis:6379
      certmagic:
        enabled: false
      mailer:
        smtp:
          enabled: false
      self_monitoring:
        dsn: http://${PROJECT_TOKEN}@localhost:80?grpc=4317
      logging:
        level: INFO
volumes:
  clickhouse-data:
  postgres-data:
  redis-data:

  SYNC_EXERCISE_IMAGES_CELERY: "True"
  SYNC_EXERCISE_VIDEOS_CELERY: "False"
  SYNC_INGREDIENTS_CELERY: "True"
  DOWNLOAD_INGREDIENTS_FROM: WGER
  CACHE_API_EXERCISES_CELERY: "True"
  WGER_USE_GUNICORN: "True"
  GUNICORN_CMD_ARGS: --workers 3 --threads 2 --worker-class gthread --timeout 240
  NUMBER_OF_PROXIES: "2"
  AXES_IPWARE_PROXY_COUNT: "2"
  AXES_IPWARE_META_PRECEDENCE_ORDER: HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR,REMOTE_ADDR
services:
  nginx:
    image: nginx:stable-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    configs:
      - source: nginx-conf
        target: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
    volumes:
      - static:/wger/static:ro
      - media:/wger/media:ro
    depends_on:
      web:
        condition: service_healthy
  web:
    image: wger/server:2.7
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment: *wger-env
    volumes:
      - static:/home/wger/static
      - media:/home/wger/media
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "-O", "/dev/null", "http://localhost:8000/api/v2/version/"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      start_period: 300s
      retries: 5
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
  celery-worker:
    image: wger/server:2.7
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["/start-worker"]
    environment: *wger-env
    volumes:
      - media:/home/wger/media
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "celery", "-A", "wger", "inspect", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      start_period: 30s
      retries: 5
    depends_on:
      web:
        condition: service_healthy
  celery-beat:
    image: wger/server:2.7
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["/start-beat"]
    environment: *wger-env
    volumes:
      - celery-beat:/home/wger/beat/
    depends_on:
      celery-worker:
        condition: service_healthy
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: wger
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: wger
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U wger -d wger"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 20
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 10
configs:
  nginx-conf:
    content: |
      upstream wger {
          server web:8000;
      }

      server {
          listen 80;
          client_max_body_size 100M;

          location / {
              proxy_pass http://wger;
              proxy_set_header Host $$http_host;
              proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $$remote_addr;
              proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $$proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
              proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $$http_x_forwarded_proto;
              proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Host $$http_host;
              proxy_redirect off;
              proxy_read_timeout 240s;
          }

          location /static/ {
              alias /wger/static/;
              add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable" always;
          }

          location /media/ {
              alias /wger/media/;
          }
      }
volumes:
  static:
  media:
  celery-beat:
  postgres-data:
  redis-data:

templates.name: WriteFreely
templates.description: Minimal, distraction-free blogging platform with federation.
templates.note: Sign in with the admin username and the generated admin password (Variables tab).
templates.compose:
services:
  writefreely:
    image: ghcr.io/writefreely/writefreely:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["-c", "/config.ini"]
    configs:
      - source: writefreely-config
        target: /config.ini
    volumes:
      # Holds the encryption keys and the SQLite database.
      - writefreely-data:/go/keys
    depends_on:
      setup:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
  # Creates the database, keys and admin account on the first start, and migrates after an upgrade.
  setup:
    image: ghcr.io/writefreely/writefreely:latest
    restart: "no"
    environment:
      ADMIN_USERNAME: ${ADMIN_USERNAME}
      ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${ADMIN_PASSWORD}
    entrypoint:
      - sh
      - -c
      - |
        set -e
        wf="/go/cmd/writefreely/writefreely -c /config.ini"
        if [ ! -f /go/keys/.installed ]; then
          rm -f /go/keys/writefreely.db
          $$wf db init
          $$wf keys generate
          $$wf user create --admin "$$ADMIN_USERNAME:$$ADMIN_PASSWORD"
          touch /go/keys/.installed
        else
          $$wf db migrate
        fi
    configs:
      - source: writefreely-config
        target: /config.ini
    volumes:
      - writefreely-data:/go/keys
configs:
  writefreely-config:
    content: |
      [server]
      port = 8080
      bind = 0.0.0.0
      templates_parent_dir = /go
      static_parent_dir = /go
      pages_parent_dir = /go
      keys_parent_dir = /go

      [database]
      type = sqlite3
      filename = /go/keys/writefreely.db

      [app]
      site_name = ${SITE_NAME}
      host = ${WRITEFREELY_URL}
      single_user = false
      open_registration = false
      min_username_len = 3
      max_blogs = 4
      federation = true
      public_stats = true
      private = false
      local_timeline = true
volumes:
  writefreely-data:

    command: ["postgres", "-c", "wal_level=logical"]

      POSTGRES_DB: zero

      DATABASE_URL: postgres://zipline:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/zipline
    volumes:
      - zipline-uploads:/zipline/uploads
      - zipline-public:/zipline/public
      - zipline-themes:/zipline/themes
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: zipline
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: zipline
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U zipline -d zipline"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 20
volumes:
  zipline-uploads:
  zipline-public:
  zipline-themes:
  postgres-data:

templates.name: ZITADEL
templates.description: Identity platform with SSO, OpenID Connect, SAML, passkeys and multi-tenancy.
templates.note: The sign-in pages run on a second domain. Open /ui/console on the main domain and sign in as zitadel-admin@zitadel.<main domain> with the admin password you set here; you choose a new password on the first sign-in. The admin password needs an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol.
templates.compose:
services:
  zitadel:
    image: ghcr.io/zitadel/zitadel:v4.19.3
    restart: unless-stopped
    user: "0"
    command: start-from-init --masterkey "${ZITADEL_MASTERKEY}"
    environment:
      ZITADEL_PORT: "8080"
      ZITADEL_EXTERNALDOMAIN: ${ZITADEL_DOMAIN}
      ZITADEL_EXTERNALPORT: "443"
      ZITADEL_EXTERNALSECURE: "true"
      ZITADEL_TLS_ENABLED: "false"
      ZITADEL_DATABASE_POSTGRES_DSN: postgresql://postgres:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/zitadel?sslmode=disable
      ZITADEL_FIRSTINSTANCE_ORG_HUMAN_PASSWORD: ${ZITADEL_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      ZITADEL_FIRSTINSTANCE_ORG_HUMAN_PASSWORDCHANGEREQUIRED: "true"
      ZITADEL_FIRSTINSTANCE_LOGINCLIENTPATPATH: /zitadel/bootstrap/login-client.pat
      ZITADEL_FIRSTINSTANCE_ORG_LOGINCLIENT_MACHINE_USERNAME: login-client
      ZITADEL_FIRSTINSTANCE_ORG_LOGINCLIENT_MACHINE_NAME: Automatically Initialized IAM_LOGIN_CLIENT
      ZITADEL_FIRSTINSTANCE_ORG_LOGINCLIENT_PAT_EXPIRATIONDATE: "2099-01-01T00:00:00Z"
      ZITADEL_DEFAULTINSTANCE_FEATURES_LOGINV2_REQUIRED: "true"
      ZITADEL_DEFAULTINSTANCE_FEATURES_LOGINV2_BASEURI: ${LOGIN_URL}/ui/v2/login/
      ZITADEL_OIDC_DEFAULTLOGINURLV2: ${LOGIN_URL}/ui/v2/login/login?authRequest=
      ZITADEL_OIDC_DEFAULTLOGOUTURLV2: ${LOGIN_URL}/ui/v2/login/logout?post_logout_redirect=
      ZITADEL_SAML_DEFAULTLOGINURLV2: ${LOGIN_URL}/ui/v2/login/login?samlRequest=
    volumes:
      - zitadel-bootstrap:/zitadel/bootstrap
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/app/zitadel", "ready"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 30s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 20s
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
  login:
    image: ghcr.io/zitadel/zitadel-login:v4.19.3
    restart: unless-stopped
    user: "0"
    environment:
      ZITADEL_API_URL: http://zitadel:8080
      NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH: /ui/v2/login
      ZITADEL_SERVICE_USER_TOKEN_FILE: /zitadel/bootstrap/login-client.pat
      ZITADEL_SESSION_COOKIE_SECRET: ${LOGIN_SESSION_COOKIE_SECRET}
      CUSTOM_REQUEST_HEADERS: Host:${ZITADEL_DOMAIN},X-Forwarded-Proto:https
    volumes:
      - zitadel-bootstrap:/zitadel/bootstrap:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/bin/sh", "-c", "node /app/healthcheck.mjs http://localhost:3000/ui/v2/login/healthy"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 30s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 20s
    depends_on:
      zitadel:
        condition: service_healthy
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: zitadel
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres -d zitadel"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 20
volumes:
  zitadel-bootstrap:
  postgres-data:
